paper_title: Search for ultralight axion dark matter in a side-band analysis of a 199Hg free-spin precession signal
coupling_convention: g_aNN derivative coupling in GeV^-1 (NOT converted to dimensionless g_an; multiply by m_N ~ 0.939 GeV to obtain dimensionless g_an)
notes: New 95% C.L. laboratory limit on axion-nucleon coupling from side-band analysis of 199Hg free spin precession at PSI, covering 1e-16 eV < m_a < 1e-13 eV with peak sensitivity g_aNN ~ 3.5e-6 GeV^-1. The paper provides no numerical table; only the peak sensitivity and mass range are stated in text. Intermediate points are extrapolated assuming the g_aNN limit scales approximately linearly with sideband frequency fa (per Eq. 13 with roughly flat noise floor), so they are approximate; the actual exclusion curve (Fig. 4) has structure (insensitive notches at multiples of fHg=7.879 Hz, sensitivity dip near 4 Hz). Coupling type is AxionNeutron per paper's statement that 199Hg is primarily sensitive to g_ann.
